dmm-2014-individual-10.prompt: During the semester, the students in a math class are divided into groups of four such that every two groups have exactly $2$ students in common and no two students are in all the groups together. Find the maximum number of such groups.
dmm-2014-individual-10.reviewNote: No official key. 7 is attained by the complements of Fano lines; the upper bound 7 was confirmed by exhaustive computer search on up to 9 students, and the written proof of the upper bound is only an outline.
